'''Pelikki''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Bird/Legends|bird]] that lived on the [[river]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], along with their [[Duck/Legends|duck]] and [[quadduck]] cousins. Thanks to their expandable throat poach, the [[Fish/Legends|fish]]-[[Diet/Legends|eating]] waterfowl could scoop up their prey while [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]]. Although adapted to the large-scale presence of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Nabooian]] [[Human/Legends|Humans]], who sometimes fed them for pleasure, the pelikki remained untamed and were still easily frightened by abrupt movements.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Duck.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Two pelikki poised for flight]]
Pelikki were a large-billed [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. They had four [[Limb/Legends|limbs]]: two functional wings and two legs ending in large feet that were awkward on land. A feathery tail sprouted from their backsides. Their heads sported [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and three fleshy growths on the upper parts. The many [[river]]s that ran across the planet's surface, including the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]], constituted their natural habitat. They used their distensible gular pouch to store prey while [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]]. The species displayed sexual dimorphism between its two [[Gender/Legends|sexes]], with males having a deep [[Color/Legends|purple]] plumage,<ref name="VDE" /> while females had more subdued gray feathers.<ref name="TPM" /> They were related to two other waterfowls, the [[Duck/Legends|ducks]] and the [[quadduck]]s, with which they shared their habitat.<ref name="VDE" />

==Behavior==
The pelikki were [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Diet/Legends|piscivores]], feeding on [[Fish/Legends|fish]], which they caught by bobbing into the [[Water/Legends|water]]. They were accustomed to [[Human/Legends|Humans]], one of the two sentient species who shared Naboo, as they could be seen in the proximity of [[City/Legends|urbanized areas]]. In the planetary [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], bird enthusiasts who strolled along the banks of the Solleu River would sometimes buy packets of small fish to feed the hungry pelikki.<ref name="VDE" /> Despite that, the birds were still easily startled by sudden noises or movements, which prompted them to move away quickly. In such situations of distress, they emitted loud quacking.<ref name="TPM" />

==History==
[[File:Naboo2.jpg|thumb|right|180px|A group of pelikki on the Solleu River]]
The pelikki were native to the world of Naboo,<ref name="VDE" /> in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] of the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAWGG">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a group of pelikki had made their home in an estuary of the Solleu River, located near the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]]. When a [[Submarine/Legends|submersible]] [[Tribubble bongo/Legends|tribubble bongo]] transporting two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] bobbed to the surface, those pelikki were surprised and flew away in fright.<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The pelikki first appeared in the [[1999]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], in which they were not named.<ref name="TPM" /> They were initially identified as ducks in an entry in the now defunct [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]], which used a picture of the Nabooian waterfowls seen in ''The Phantom Menace''.<ref name="databank">{{DB|creature|duck|duck}}</ref> However, the [[2012]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]'' later [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] the birds seen in the movie into pelikki, a species related to ducks but sufficiently different from them to receive a name of their own. The pelikki's name and expandable gular pouch make them resemble<ref name="VDE" /> real-life [[Wikipedia:Pelican|pelicans]], a genus of large ocean birds.<ref name="Pelicans">{{WebCite|url=https://www.nationalgeographic.com/animals/birds/group/pelicans|text=Pelicans, Pelican Pictures, Pelican Facts - National Geographic|work=[http://www.nationalgeographic.com National Geographic]|archivedate=20171204021718}}</ref>
